chunks: “Whoever finds the coolness of our love upon his heart, let him frequently make du'a for his mother, for she did not betray his father.”

key_terms.الدُّعَاءَ: supplication, calling upon Allah for someone
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.بَرْدَ: the coolness or soothing sweetness felt inwardly
key_terms.حُبِّنَا: love for the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.قَلْبِهِ: his heart, the inner place of faith and attachment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about loving the Ahl al-Bayt and praying for one’s mother?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that love of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام is a noble sign within the heart. He then directs the believer to respond with gratitude toward his mother by increasing du'a for her, recognizing her fidelity and virtue.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4745 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever feels the coolness of our (Ahlulbayt (as)) love in his heart should frequently pray for his mother, for she did not betray his father."
